programme.desc: With their ten-year class reunion approaching, two best friends decide to fake successful business careers to impress their former classmates.

programme.title: Self Reliance
programme.desc: Tommy Walcott takes part in a reality show, where he strives to overcome challenges to outwit the hunters who threaten to kill him.

programme.title: X-Men
programme.desc: A gifted group of individuals faces off against a militant faction aiming to reshape the world order in a battle rooted in fear, power and the hope for understanding.

programme.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: Caesar, a chimpanzee, has been with Will ever since he was little and with a new drug he is able to think and react like humans. When Caesar finds himself subjected to injustice, he decides to revolt.

programme.title: Elysium
programme.desc: In 2154, where the rich reside in an advanced space station and the rest of the people thrive in poverty on Earth, a former criminal sets off on a mission to reinstate equality.

programme.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
programme.desc: Shang-Chi, a martial artist, lives a quiet life after he leaves his father and the shadowy Ten Rings organisation behind. Years later, he is forced to confront his past when the Ten Rings attack him.

programme.title: Koffee With Karan
programme.desc: When Bollywood celebrities make themselves comfortable on Karan Johar's couch, plenty of secrets are revealed over a lively cup of coffee.

programme.title: Inside Out 2
programme.desc: Thirteen-year-old Riley tackles high school with her personified emotions guiding her decisions. Soon her newfound feelings cause turmoil and force her to redefine her sense of self.

programme.title: Black Widow
programme.desc: Natasha Romanoff, also known as Black Widow, is faced with the challenge of addressing a sensitive issue from her past when a potential threat emerges linked to her history.

programme.title: Alien: Covenant
programme.desc: Covenant, a colony ship, receives a radio transmission from a planet, leading the crew to go on a mission to explore it. However, things get complicated when they encounter deadly aliens.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA

programme.desc: S4 E7 — Burger Kitchen The explosive drama continues as Gordon is still in Los Angeles struggling to bring together the fragmented Saffron family and their failing restaurant, the Burger Kitchen. Last time, son Daniel nearly came to blows with the head chef, and Gordon was shocked to learn that dad Alan had taken from Daniel's inheritance, without his knowledge, to help fund the start-up of the restaurant.
programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA

programme.desc: S4 E4 — Luigi's Gordon travels to Orange County, Southern California, to try to save an Italian restaurant from imminent destruction. Luigi's was a successful restaurant with a great reputation until Dominic decided to retire to Italy and brought in son Tony to help run it. Familial fighting and an unappetising menu of 126 items have let the restaurant down the drain. Can Gordon fix it, or is Luigi's beyond repair?
programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA

programme.desc: S4 E12 — Park's Edge In Atlanta, Gordon helps first-time restaurant owners Richard and Jorge. Their restaurant, Park's Edge, has been open for three years but is in big trouble due to constant fighting between them, poor food and a bad vibe in the tight-knit neighbourhood. Gordon comes up with a brilliant plan to resolve the issue within the community, but then a rogue chef threatens to ruin everything.
programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA

programme.desc: S4 E8 — Greek at the Harbor Gordon travels to Ventura Harbour in Southern California to help a family-run Greek restaurant facing big problems that haven't taken a profit for two years. Makis Mikelatos and his wife Lynn have run the restaurant, the Greek at the Harbour, for 17 years, but Makis - who works 17 hours a day, seven days a week, and rarely takes a holiday - is exhausted, and if he doesn't slow down he's in danger of collapse.
programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA

programme.desc: S12 E2 — A Tale of Two Springfields When trying to deal with a rogue badger, Homer discovers that the area code for the Simpsons' half of Springfield (the poor half) has changed. Area code and class rivalries split Springfield in two and Homer becomes mayor of New Springfield, but his reign doesn't go well. Only The Who can save the day.
programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.desc: Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.
programme.title: Peter Rabbit

programme.desc: Dracula, who operates a high-end resort away from the human world, goes into overprotective mode when a boy discovers the resort and falls for the count's teenage daughter.
programme.title: Hotel Transylvania

programme.desc: Concerned that his half-human grandson isn't showing his vampire side, Dracula decides to put his grandson through 'monster' boot camp. Then, Dracula's father unexpectedly pays a visit.
programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 2

programme.desc: Mavis surprises Dracula with plans for a fun-filled summer voyage on a monster cruise. As the pack starts enjoying colossal buffets and exotic excursions, Drac finds himself falling for the ship's intriguing but dangerous captain. He soon learns that trying to balance family, friends and romance might just be too much to handle. Even for the world's most powerful vampire.
programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 3: A Monster Vacation

programme.desc: The lives of Gomez and Morticia Addams are thrown into disarray when a scheming siren attempts to pass off her son as Gomez's long-lost brother Fester. Once installed in the family's spooky mansion, mother and son set their minds on stealing the family fortune.
programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.desc: With Wednesday and Pugsley off to summer camp, a greedy nanny plots to marry and murder wealthy Uncle Fester.
programme.title: Addams Family Values

programme.desc: Yogi, Boo Boo, and Ranger Smith team up to try to stop the mayor from closing Jellystone Park and selling it to loggers.
programme.title: Yogi Bear

programme.desc: A young boy and his pals set out to discover what bloodcurdling secrets lie behind the front door of the scary house across the street.
programme.title: Monster House

programme.desc: Poppy, the optimistic leader of the trolls, and Branch, her polar opposite, embark on an adventure that takes them far beyond the only world they've ever known.
programme.title: Trolls

programme.desc: A life-saving surgery fuses together a police officer and his faithful police dog -- and Dog Man is born. Learning to embrace his new identity, Dog Man must stop feline supervillain Petey the Cat from cloning himself and going on a crime spree.
programme.title: Dog Man

programme.desc: There's trouble brewing in Bikini Bottom. Someone has stolen King Neptune's crown, and it looks like Mr. Krabs, SpongeBob's boss, is the culprit. Though he's just been passed over for the promotion of his dreams, SpongeBob stands by his boss, and along with his best pal Patrick, sets out on a treacherous mission to Shell City to reclaim the crown and save Mr. Krabs' life.
programme.title: The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie

programme.desc: SpongeBob goes on a quest to discover a stolen recipe that takes him to our world, where he tangles with a pirate.
programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water

programme.desc: A new baby's arrival impacts a family, told from the point of view of a delightfully unreliable narrator, a wildly imaginative Seven-year-old named Tim. The most unusual Boss Baby arrives at Tim's home in a taxi, wearing a suit and carrying a briefcase. The instant sibling rivalry must soon be put aside when Tim discovers that Boss Baby is actually a spy on a secret mission, and only he can help thwart a dastardly plot that involves an epic battle between puppies and babies.
programme.title: The Boss Baby

programme.desc: Tommy and his plucky pals go on a forest adventure in his father's latest invention, the Reptar Wagon.
programme.title: The Rugrats Movie

programme.desc: The children and their bickering family are stranded on a desert island. Fortunately help is at hand from the Thornberry family, who are visiting the island to film a rare snow leopard. Once again, animal-understanding Eliza saves the day.
programme.title: Rugrats Go Wild

programme.desc: Spoiled by their upbringing and with no idea of what wildlife is really like, Alex the lion, Marty the zebra, Gloria the hippo and hypochondriac giraffe Melman swap New York's Central Park Zoo for Madagascar.
programme.title: Madagascar

programme.desc: The sequel to 'Madagascar', in which New York Zoo animals, Alex the Lion, Marty the Zebra, Melman the Giraffe and Gloria the Hippo, still stranded on Madagascar, start to leave the island. All of a sudden, they land in the wilderness of Africa, where Alex meets the rest of his family, but has trouble communicating with them after spending so much time at the Central Park Zoo. A DreamWorks animation.
programme.title: Madagascar: Escape 2 Africa

programme.desc: Unknown to humans, all-out war between cats and dogs has raged since the beginning of time. Now the cats face defeat if scientist Professor Brody can perfect a formula that will make all humans non-allergic to dogs. The cats' leader, Mr Tinkles, plans to steal the serum, but first he must get past fearless dog agent Lou who, thanks to a mistake in recruitment, guards the Brody family.
programme.title: Cats & Dogs

programme.desc: The canine and feline species join forces to thwart the evil plans of a rogue cat who dreams of global domination.
programme.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore

programme.desc: A teenage video-game whiz is recruited as an interstellar fighter pilot by an emissary from a league of planets.
programme.title: The Last Starfighter

programme.desc: Big-budget tale of the battle for survival in a world where dry land has disappeared with the melting of the polar ice caps. One man, who has become amphibious, tries to protect survivors on an artificial atoll made from scrap metal by taking on a gang of marauding pirates. He is also intent on discovering if there is any truth in the myth that there is still some land left above water.
programme.title: Waterworld

programme.desc: On his return from the Crusades, Robin of Locksley learns that his father has been murdered by the tyrannical Sheriff of Nottingham and embarks on a campaign of guerrilla warfare to protect King Richard's throne. Fight scenes are lively and inventive, and a set piece fought under the forest canopy pulls out all the stops.
programme.title: Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves

programme.desc: In an attempt to avenge the violent death of his parents, Bruce Wayne fights to rid the city of crime and in particular, his nemesis the Joker. However, his defences come down when an attractive journalist tries to track down the truth behind sightings of a huge bat-like figure in the sky.
programme.title: Batman

programme.desc: After Selina Kyle sees more than she should in her boss's office, she has an 'accident', falling from the top floor of the building to the street below. Awoken by the licking of cats, she is surprised to find herself still very much alive. She vows to take revenge on her boss and becomes a female avenger, defending women under attack and providing assistance to Batman's efforts to keep the streets of Gotham safe.
programme.title: Batman Returns

programme.desc: DA Harvey Dent and vengeful scientist The Riddler plan to take down Batman, as Dent wrongly believes that it is Batman's fault he was disfigured, and the scientist is angry with Bruce Wayne for rejecting his experiments. The Gotham City superhero is going to need his new partner, boy wonder Robin, but will he be able to cope with the distraction of sexy doctor Chase Meridian?
programme.title: Batman Forever

programme.desc: Batman battles super-villain Mr Freeze and seductive eco-terrorist Poison Ivy. With Freeze planning a permanent winter, faithful butler Alfred falling to a mysterious illness, and Ivy coming between the caped crusader and Robin, teaming up with Batgirl is the crime-fighting duo's only chance of saving the day.
programme.title: Batman & Robin

programme.desc: A kidnapped family and their two murderous captors confront bloodthirsty demons after crossing the Mexican border.
programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn

programme.desc: A bank robber headed for a Mexican heist stumbles into a bar frequented by the undead, where he's turned into a vampire.
programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 2: Texas Blood Money

programme.desc: In 2274, computers rule a hermetically sealed city housing the survivors of a holocaust that has decimated the earth. Life is hedonistic and happy for the city's inhabitants; unfortunately they must be terminated when they reach 30. When Logan 5, a trained hunter for the system, grows intrigued by a beautiful young woman, he is forced to question the fundamental principles of his society and decides he must flee.
programme.title: Logan's Run

programme.desc: Kirk, now an admiral, is called upon to take command of his old ship one last time in order to intercept a bizarre and deadly force heading towards Earth. One by one, he reassembles the original crew, and they set out to save the planet.
programme.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture

programme.desc: The past returns to haunt Admiral James Kirk when he and his crew become locked in a battle of wits with an old nemesis. His enemy Khan is looking for revenge and a potentially destructive device.
programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan

programme.desc: Kirk and the Enterprise crew defy Starfleet and return to the Genesis planet to reunite Spock's body and spirit.
programme.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock

programme.desc: Kirk and company travel back in time to 20th-century San Francisco, where two whales hold the key to Earth's future.
programme.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home

programme.desc: DA Harvey Dent and vengeful scientist The Riddler plan to take down Batman, as Dent wrongly believes that it is Batman's fault he was disfigured, and the scientist is angry with Bruce Wayne for rejecting his experiments. The Gotham City superhero is going to need his new partner, boy wonder Robin, but will he be able to cope with the distraction of sexy doctor Chase Meridian?
programme.title: Batman Forever

programme.desc: Batman battles super-villain Mr Freeze and seductive eco-terrorist Poison Ivy. With Freeze planning a permanent winter, faithful butler Alfred falling to a mysterious illness, and Ivy coming between the caped crusader and Robin, teaming up with Batgirl is the crime-fighting duo's only chance of saving the day.
programme.title: Batman & Robin

programme.desc: In a desolate near future, vicious motorcycle gangs roam the wastelands attacking what is left of civilisation. With law and order in chaos, a tough police patrolman enforces a new kind of law - cold-blooded revenge - when his family is murdered by one of the gangs.
programme.title: Mad Max

programme.desc: Fast-paced apocalyptic adventure. In a hostile post-World War III world, petrol is the most precious commodity and people will do anything to get it. Embittered lone warrior Max agrees to help when an oil-producing community comes under attack from a violent gang determined to get its hands on their fuel.
programme.title: Mad Max 2: The Road Warrior

programme.desc: Set in a lawless, post-apocalyptic wilderness. To retrieve his camel train, hero Max enters the seedy, savage, rough-hewn precincts of Bartertown. Forced to fight for his possessions, he breaks the only rule of the city and is banished. In the desert, he is rescued by a tribe of feral children who see him as a prophesied saviour.
programme.title: Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome

programme.desc: Vietnam veteran John J Rambo is pushed too far by the sheriff of a small American town. After being wrongfully arrested, he escapes and leads lawmen and an army detachment on a chase through the mountains.
programme.title: First Blood

programme.desc: War veteran John Rambo takes on the entire Vietnamese army, plus Soviet advisers, when he is released from prison and sent back to present-day Vietnam in search of American prisoners of war still being held in enemy custody.
programme.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II

programme.desc: Reluctant one-man army Rambo goes into action against brutal Soviet invaders in Afghanistan. Sought out in a Buddhist monastery retreat, Rambo declines his former commander's request for help to deliver missiles to the mujahideen, but when his superior is captured and imprisoned, the hulking hero brings out the big guns.
programme.title: Rambo III

programme.desc: This week's edition of the Cinema List is all about epic storytelling. From The Shawshank Redemption to Dunkirk, witness unforgettable tales of hope, courage and survival.
programme.title: The Cinema List: Epic Storytelling

programme.desc: Kirk and the Enterprise crew defy Starfleet and return to the Genesis planet to reunite Spock's body and spirit.
programme.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock

programme.desc: Kirk and company travel back in time to 20th-century San Francisco, where two whales hold the key to Earth's future.
programme.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home

programme.desc: The Enterprise crew falls under the spell of Spock's half-brother, a renegade Vulcan on an obsessive quest to find God.
programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier

programme.desc: The Klingon Empire is falling apart, and they want peace with the Federation. However, when an unprotected Klingon craft is fired on, Kirk and Dr McCoy are placed on trial for murder.
programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country

programme.desc: Following the death of a local diver, a New York palaeontologist is sent out to help the local fisheries warden investigate the case.
programme.title: Lake Placid

programme.desc: Filmmaker Terri Flores is travelling deep in the Amazon jungle looking for a forgotten tribe. Terri and her crew, which includes an anthropologist and a cameraman, come across Paul, who is stranded on the riverbank. He offers to help them find the tribe, but his secretive behaviour puts everyone on edge. They realise too late that he's using them to find a legendary anaconda that's worth a fortune, if they can catch it.
programme.title: Anaconda

programme.desc: Fang-in-cheek tale about a single-parent family who move to the coastal town of Santa Clara where the local juvenile delinquents are actually a pack of vampires.
programme.title: The Lost Boys

programme.desc: Ash is transported back to medieval days, where he is captured by the dreaded Lord Arthur. Aided by the deadly chainsaw that has become his only friend, Ash is sent on a perilous mission to recover the Book of the Dead, a powerful tome that gives its owner the power to summon an army of ghouls.
programme.title: Army of Darkness

programme.desc: The Klingon Empire is falling apart, and they want peace with the Federation. However, when an unprotected Klingon craft is fired on, Kirk and Dr McCoy are placed on trial for murder.
programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country

programme.desc: The maiden voyage of the third Starship Enterprise is jeopardised by mad scientist Soran. Only one man knows how to stop the boffin, but he's been dead 78 years.
programme.title: Star Trek Generations

programme.desc: This week's edition of the Cinema List is all about epic storytelling. From The Shawshank Redemption to Dunkirk, witness unforgettable tales of hope, courage and survival.
programme.title: The Cinema List: Epic Storytelling

programme.desc: Picard and his crew face a Borg offensive as they try to ensure that a 21st-century scientist keeps a date with destiny.
programme.title: Star Trek: First Contact

programme.desc: A Federation mission to the planet Ba'ku takes a dangerous turn when a malfunctioning android, Data, takes a cultural task force hostage. When Capt. Picard and his crew investigate, they uncover the truth about the Federation mission: It was actually a systematic ploy by the Son'a to displace the peaceful inhabitants of Ba'ku. Now Picard and his crew must thwart the plot even while experiencing strange side effects from exposure to the planet's surface.
programme.title: Star Trek: Insurrection

programme.desc: A reprogrammed killer cyborg arrives in Los Angeles to protect a future leader from a shape-shifting assassin.
programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day

programme.desc: Humanity faces extinction after a giant comet is discovered heading for Earth. As a desperate mission is launched to stop it, families, leaders and ordinary people confront fear, sacrifice and survival as the countdown begins.
programme.title: Deep Impact

programme.desc: Doug Quaid has an ordinary life, although he dreams nightly of Mars - a planet he has never visited. Determined to find the meaning of these dreams, he visits Rekall Inc - a specialist in memory implants - intent on buying a memory trip to Mars, but the implant brings to the surface long-lost clues as to Quaid's true identity.
programme.title: Total Recall

programme.title: Deep Impact

programme.title: Star Trek Generations

programme.title: Star Trek: First Contact

programme.desc: Six years after defeating the Gremlins, Billy and Kate have grown up and moved to New York. However, Billy stumbles across Gizmo in a genetics lab and when he gets wet, all hell breaks loose, and the stage is set for more deliciously bad taste humour.
programme.title: Gremlins 2: The New Batch

programme.desc: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis, quickly christened 'Joker' by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant, and pudgy Private Lawrence, nicknamed 'Gomer Pyle', as they endure the rigours of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering, and eventually participating in, the Battle of Hue.
programme.title: Full Metal Jacket

programme.desc: Young Jim has to grow up fast after the Japanese invade Shanghai. Separated from his parents and alone in a prisoner of war camp, Jim must fight to survive.
programme.title: Empire of the Sun

programme.desc: Bittersweet film about a gang of four 12-year-old boys growing up in Oregon in the 1950s. The story is told in flashback years afterwards by one of the boys - now a writer - and revolves around their search through the countryside around their hometown for the body of a missing teenager, thought to have been killed by a train. Adapted from 'The Body', a novella by Stephen King.
programme.title: Stand by Me

programme.desc: Classic Oscar-winning tough comedy adventure set in First World War Africa featuring a hard-drinking, woman-hating owner of the 'African Queen', a decrepit steamer that trades up and down the river, and a strait-laced spinster sister of missionary Rev Samuel Sayer, whom he has agreed to take back to civilisation.
programme.title: The African Queen

programme.desc: Visually exquisite biopic of Toulouse-Lautrec, the crippled painter whose work perfectly captured the spirit of bohemian Paris in the naughty 1890s. Portrayed as an embittered loner, he is tormented by his doomed relationships with prostitute Marie Charlet and sympathetic model Myriamme.
programme.title: Moulin Rouge

programme.desc: A sports agent who makes the mistake of saying what he believes finds himself sacked and abandoned by all his clients apart from small time footballer Rod Tidwell. Maguire's personal life starts to fall apart as he's torn between love and money in Cameron Crowe's metaphor on Americans' need for success and money.
programme.title: Jerry Maguire

programme.desc: Bittersweet film about a gang of four 12-year-old boys growing up in Oregon in the 1950s. The story is told in flashback years afterwards by one of the boys - now a writer - and revolves around their search through the countryside around their hometown for the body of a missing teenager, thought to have been killed by a train. Adapted from 'The Body', a novella by Stephen King.
programme.title: Stand by Me

programme.desc: A Secret Service agent-turned-bodyguard finds danger and romance while protecting an entertainer from a stalker.
programme.title: The Bodyguard

programme.desc: Drama about a gay lawyer's fight against unlawful dismissal by his homophobic employer. Forced to lead a double life because of the bigoted views held by his law firm, he discovers he is HIV-positive during a routine medical examination and is soon afterwards is fired for incompetence.
programme.title: Philadelphia

programme.desc: While widow Aurora fends off a stream of admirers, daughter Emma learns the hard facts of married life.
programme.title: Terms of Endearment

programme.desc: A CIA agent comes up against a duplicitous American government during his quest to nab a Colombian drug lord.

programme.title: Terms of Endearment

programme.desc: Andy Dufresne and Ellis Boyd 'Red' Redding are two prisoners serving long sentences in the vicious Shawshank jail. The two come to terms with their imprisonment while surviving the sadistic acts of prison warden Samuel Norton, and for both, a different sort of redemption awaits.
programme.title: The Shawshank Redemption

programme.desc: Paul Edgecomb, the head guard of death row, just wants life for him, his colleagues and the condemned to be nice and easy. However, when John Coffey, a massive man convicted of brutally killing a pair of young sisters, arrives, things start to get strange. Beyond his simple, naïve nature and a deathly fear of the dark, Coffey seems to possess a prodigious, supernatural gift. Paul begins to question whether Coffey was truly guilty of murdering the two girls.
programme.title: The Green Mile

programme.desc: The year is 1939, and England is at war. A passionate woman trapped inside a sterile marriage, Sarah Miles is immediately and irresistibly attracted to brooding novelist Maurice Bendrix when they meet at a party given by Sarah's worthy but unexciting civil servant husband, Henry. They begin a passionate, illicit and sexually liberating love affair.
programme.title: The End of the Affair

programme.desc: At the opening party of a colossal, but poorly constructed office building, a massive fire breaks out that threatens to destroy the tower and everyone in it.
programme.title: The Towering Inferno

programme.desc: An epic historical drama set in the 12th century in which Henry II summons his fragmented family to a reunion. There follows a series of battles, both political and personal, as his wife Eleanor and her three sons scheme to further their own claim to the king's empire.
programme.title: The Lion in Winter

programme.desc: Re-creation of the life of comic genius Charlie Chaplin, from his humble beginnings in south London through his early days in British vaudeville, his silent movie career in America and his late masterpieces. His turbulent personal life saw four marriages and an enforced exile from the US - though he returned to receive an honorary Oscar in 1972.
programme.title: Chaplin

programme.desc: Frederick Manion, an army lieutenant, is arrested for the murder of bartender Barney Quill. In defence, he claims that the victim had beaten and raped his wife. With such evidence somewhat lacking, Manion's lawyer, Paul Biegler attempts to save his defendant from prosecution, setting his assistants in search of witnesses.
programme.title: Anatomy of a Murder

programme.desc: A CIA agent comes up against a duplicitous American government during his quest to nab a Colombian drug lord.
programme.title: Clear and Present Danger

programme.desc: Andy Dufresne and Ellis Boyd 'Red' Redding are two prisoners serving long sentences in the vicious Shawshank jail. The two come to terms with their imprisonment while surviving the sadistic acts of prison warden Samuel Norton, and for both, a different sort of redemption awaits.
programme.title: The Shawshank Redemption

programme.desc: A violent and uncompromising police officer hunts for a psychopath who holds the city of San Francisco to ransom. Although the officer's unorthodox methods do not endear him to his superiors, the mayor reluctantly agrees that Harry Callahan seems to be the right cop for the job.
programme.title: Dirty Harry

programme.desc: Lavish thriller about an idealistic federal agent who vows to bring down Al Capone and his underworld crime syndicate in Prohibition-era Chicago. With police corruption rife, he forms a special team for the task and relies on a veteran street cop - passed over for promotion because he is honest - to clean up the force and trap Capone.
programme.title: The Untouchables

programme.desc: In an England of the future, Alex de Large is the leader of a gang of droogs whose pastime is violence, sex and murder, but whose eventual punishment is almost as extreme and violent as his crimes. Betrayed by the other members of his gang, he is arrested and offered an experimental treatment in order to shorten his sentence.
programme.title: A Clockwork Orange

programme.title: Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome

programme.desc: In a desolate near future, vicious motorcycle gangs roam the wastelands attacking what is left of civilisation. With law and order in chaos, a tough police patrolman enforces a new kind of law - cold-blooded revenge - when his family is murdered by one of the gangs.
programme.title: Mad Max

programme.desc: Fast-paced apocalyptic adventure. In a hostile post-World War III world, petrol is the most precious commodity and people will do anything to get it. programme.desc: The curse of an ancient mummy protects buried treasure in the Egyptian desert. An American mercenary who knows of the secret location is rescued from a Cairo prison by an English historian and her brother, and together they set off on a hunt. Along the way, the trio encounter flesh-eating scarab beetles, killer sandstorms, and reincarnated demons.
programme.title: The Mummy

programme.desc: The evil mummy Imhotep returns to wreak havoc as he resumes his relentless search for power and immortality. To make matters worse, another ancient evil has been unleashed, even more dangerous than Imhotep. Only the heroic Rick O'Connell and his intrepid Egyptologist wife stand in the way of these twin terrors as they embark upon a desperate mission to save the world.
programme.title: The Mummy Returns

programme.desc: In a time before the pyramids, an evil king threatens to take over the world, so the leaders of the remaining tribes under threat call upon a desert warrior to help them defeat the wicked one and his brutal hordes. As the warrior battles against the evil around him, he is preparing for a final showdown that will decide if it is to be his destiny to become the great Scorpion King.
programme.title: The Scorpion King

programme.desc: Beginning in ancient China, the ruthless Emperor Han will stop at nothing to gain control of the region. Many years on, in the 1940s, Han's tomb is discovered, and Rick O'Connell and his wife Evelyn get drawn into a plot to resurrect the emperor and restore him to power.

programme.desc: After being branded a traitor following a disastrous mission in Prague, an elite intelligence agent recruits a team of operatives to help him retrieve a computer disk that can clear his name.
programme.title: Mission: Impossible

programme.desc: IMF agent Ethan Hunt is sent to Sydney to find and destroy a genetically modified disease called Chimera after a rogue colleague kills the diseases creator and makes off with the remedy.
programme.title: Mission: Impossible II

programme.desc: Now a trainer for IMF recruits, superspy Ethan Hunt is called back to active duty to confront the toughest foe he has ever faced: Owen Davian, an international broker of arms and information who is as cunning as he is ruthless. As Ethan searches for the missing agent, Davian emerges to threaten him and all that he holds dear, including the woman that he loves.
programme.title: Mission: Impossible III

programme.desc: After the IMF are implicated in the bombing of the Kremlin, Ethan Hunt and his new team go rogue. In order to clear their organisation's name, they track down a dangerous terrorist named Kurt Hendricks. Hendricks has gained access to Russian nuclear launch codes and is planning a strike on the United States, but will the new team be able to stop the impending disaster?
programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Ghost Protocol

programme.desc: Ethan Hunt and his team take on their most impossible mission yet to eradicate the Syndicate -- a highly skilled, international organisation dedicated to creating a new world order via a series of terrorist attacks.
programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Rogue Nation

programme.desc: Ethan Hunt and the IMF team join forces with CIA assassin August Walker to prevent a disaster of epic proportions. Arms dealer John Lark and a group of terrorists known as the Apostles plan to use three plutonium cores for a simultaneous nuclear attack on the Vatican, Jerusalem and Mecca. When the weapons go missing, Ethan and his crew find themselves in a desperate race against time to prevent them from falling into the wrong hands.
programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Fallout

programme.title: Yesterday (2019)
programme.desc: Jack Malik is a struggling singer-songwriter in an English seaside town whose dreams of fame are rapidly fading, despite the fierce devotion and support of his childhood best friend, Ellie. After a freak bus accident during a mysterious global blackout, Jack wakes up to discover that The Beatles have never existed. Performing songs by the greatest band in history to a world that has never heard them, Jack becomes on overnight sensation with a little help from his agent. (Romantic comedy / Music) - 2019

Picard and his crew investigate, they uncover the truth about the Federation mission: It was actually a systematic ploy by the Son'a to displace the peaceful inhabitants of Ba'ku. Now Picard and his crew must thwart the plot even while experiencing strange side effects from exposure to the planet's surface. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Romance, Science Fiction) - 1998-12-11

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: A reprogrammed killer cyborg arrives in Los Angeles to protect a future leader from a shape-shifting assassin. (Action, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction, Thriller) - 1991-07-01

programme.title: Deep Impact
programme.desc: Humanity faces extinction after a giant comet is discovered heading for Earth. As a desperate mission is launched to stop it, families, leaders and ordinary people confront fear, sacrifice and survival as the countdown begins. (Action, Adventure, Drama, Movie, Science Fiction) - 1998-05-08

programme.title: Lake Placid
programme.desc: Following the death of a local diver, a New York palaeontologist is sent out to help the local fisheries warden investigate the case. (Action, Comedy, Horror, Movie, Science Fiction) - 1999-07-16

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Filmmaker Terri Flores is travelling deep in the Amazon jungle looking for a forgotten tribe. Terri and her crew, which includes an anthropologist and a cameraman, come across Paul, who is stranded on the riverbank. He offers to help them find the tribe, but his secretive behaviour puts everyone on edge. They realize too late that he's using them to find a legendary anaconda that's worth a fortune, if they can catch it. (Adventure, Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 1997-07-11

programme.title: The Lost Boys
programme.desc: Fang-in-cheek tale about a single-parent family who move to the coastal town of Santa Clara where the local juvenile delinquents are actually a pack of vampires. (Comedy, Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 1987-07-31

programme.title: Total Recall
programme.desc: Doug Quaid has an ordinary life, although he dreams nightly of Mars - a planet he has never visited. Determined to find the meaning of these dreams, he visits Rekall Inc - a specialist in memory implants - intent on buying a memory trip to Mars, but the implant brings to the surface long-lost clues as to Quaid's true identity. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1990-06-01

programme.title: Star Trek Generations
programme.desc: The maiden voyage of the third Starship Enterprise is jeopardised by mad scientist Soran. Only one man knows how to stop the boffin, but he's been dead 78 years. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction) - 1994-11-18

programme.title: Star Trek: First Contact
programme.desc: Picard and his crew face a Borg offensive as they try to ensure that a 21st-century scientist keeps a date with destiny. (Action, Adventure, Documentary, Drama, Movie) - 1996-11-22

programme.title: Gremlins 2: The New Batch
programme.desc: Six years after defeating the Gremlins, Billy and Kate have grown up and moved to New York. However, Billy stumbles across Gizmo in a genetics lab and when he gets wet, all hell breaks loose, and the stage is set for more deliciously bad taste humour. (Comedy, Fantasy, Horror, Movie) - 1990-06-15

programme.title: Full Metal Jacket
programme.desc: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis, quickly christened 'Joker' by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant, and pudgy Private Lawrence, nicknamed 'Gomer Pyle', as they endure the rigours of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering, and eventually participating in, the bloody Battle of Hué. (Drama, Historical drama, Movie, War) - 1987-06-01

programme.title: Empire of the Sun
programme.desc: Young Jim has to grow up fast after the Japanese invade Shanghai. Separated from his parents and alone in a prisoner of war camp, Jim must fight to survive. (Adventure, Drama, History, Movie, War) - 1987-12-09

programme.title: Stand by Me
programme.desc: Bittersweet film about a gang of four 12-year-old boys growing up in Oregon in the 1950s. The story is told in flashback years afterwards by one of the boys - now a writer - and revolves around their search through the countryside around their hometown for the body of a missing teenager, thought to have been killed by a train. Adapted from `The Body', a novella by Stephen King. (Adventure, Comedy drama, Drama, Movie) - 1986-08-08

programme.title: The African Queen
programme.desc: Classic Oscar-winning tough comedy adventure set in First World War Africa featuring a hard-drinking, woman-hating owner of the 'African Queen', a decrepit steamer that trades up and down the river, and a strait-laced spinster sister of missionary Rev Samuel Sayer, whom he has agreed to take back to civilisation. (Adventure, Drama, Movie, Romance, War) - 1951

programme.title: Moulin Rouge
programme.desc: Visually exquisite biopic of Toulouse-Lautrec, the crippled painter whose work perfectly captured the spirit of bohemian Paris in the naughty 1890s. Portrayed as an embittered loner, he is tormented by his doomed relationships with prostitute Marie Charlet and sympathetic model Myriamme. (Biography, Drama, Movie) - 1952

programme.title: Jerry Maguire
programme.desc: A sports agent who makes the mistake of saying what he believes finds himself sacked and abandoned by all his clients apart from small time footballer Rod Tidwell. Maguire's personal life starts to fall apart as he's torn between love and money in Cameron Crowe's metaphor on Americans' need for success and money. (Comedy, Drama, Movie, Romance, Romantic comedy) - 1996-12-06

programme.title: The Shawshank Redemption
programme.desc: Andy Dufresne and Ellis Boyd 'Red' Redding are two prisoners serving long sentences in the vicious Shawshank jail. The two come to terms with their imprisonment while surviving the sadistic acts of prison warden Samuel Norton, and for both, a different sort of redemption awaits. (Crime, Drama, Movie) - 1994-09-01

programme.title: The Green Mile
programme.desc: Paul Edgecomb, the head guard of death row, just wants life for him, his colleagues and the condemned to be nice and easy. However, when John Coffey, a massive man convicted of brutally killing a pair of young sisters, arrives, things start to get strange. Beyond his simple, naïve nature and a deathly fear of the dark, Coffey seems to possess a prodigious, supernatural gift. Paul begins to question whether Coffey was truly guilty of murdering the two girls. (Crime, Drama, Fantasy, Movie) - 1999-12-06

programme.title: The End of the Affair
programme.desc: The year is 1939, and England is at war. A passionate woman trapped inside a sterile marriage, Sarah Miles is immediately and irresistibly attracted to brooding novelist Maurice Bendrix when they meet at a party given by Sarah's worthy but unexciting civil servant husband, Henry. They begin a passionate, illicit and sexually liberating love affair. (Drama, Movie) - 1999-12-02

programme.title: The Towering Inferno
programme.desc: At the opening party of a colossal, but poorly constructed office building, a massive fire breaks out that threatens to destroy the tower and everyone in it. (Action, Movie, Thriller) - 1974-12-14

programme.title: The Lion in Winter
programme.desc: An epic historical drama set in the 12th century in which Henry II summons his fragmented family to a reunion. There follows a series of battles, both political and personal, as his wife Eleanor and her three sons scheme to further their own claim to the king's empire. (Historical drama, Movie) - 1968-10-30

programme.title: Chaplin
programme.desc: Re-creation of the life of comic genius Charlie Chaplin, from his humble beginnings in south London through his early days in British vaudeville, his silent movie career in America and his late masterpieces. His turbulent personal life saw four marriages and an enforced exile from the US - though he returned to receive an honorary Oscar in 1972. (Biography, Movie) - 1992-12-18

programme.title: Anatomy of a Murder
programme.desc: Frederick Manion, an army lieutenant, is arrested for the murder of bartender Barney Quill. In defence, he claims that the victim had beaten and raped his wife. With such evidence somewhat lacking, Manion's lawyer, Paul Biegler attempts to save his defendant from prosecution, setting his assistants in search of witnesses. (Crime drama, Movie, Mystery) - 1959

programme.desc: A CIA agent comes up against a duplicitous American government during his quest to nab a Colombian drug lord. (Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 1994-08-03

programme.desc: A violent and uncompromising police officer hunts for a psychopath who holds the city of San Francisco to ransom. Although the officer's unorthodox methods do not endear him to his superiors, the mayor reluctantly agrees that Harry Callahan seems to be the right cop for the job. (Action, Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 1971-01-01

programme.title: The Untouchables
programme.desc: Lavish thriller about an idealistic federal agent who vows to bring down Al Capone and his underworld crime syndicate in Prohibition-era Chicago. With police corruption rife, he forms a special team for the task and relies on a veteran street cop - passed over for promotion because he is honest - to clean up the force and trap Capone. (Crime drama, Movie) - 1987-06-03

programme.title: A Clockwork Orange
programme.desc: In an England of the future, Alex de Large is the leader of a gang of droogs whose pastime is violence, sex and murder, but whose eventual punishment is almost as extreme and violent as his crimes. Betrayed by the other members of his gang, he is arrested and offered an experimental treatment in order to shorten his sentence. (Dark comedy, Movie) - 1971-02-02

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: In an attempt to avenge the violent death of his parents, Bruce Wayne fights to rid the city of crime and in particular, his nemesis the Joker. However, his defences come down when an attractive journalist tries to track down the truth behind sightings of a huge bat-like figure in the sky. (Action, Adventure, Crime, Fantasy, Movie) - 1989-06-23

programme.title: Batman Returns
programme.desc: After Selina Kyle sees more than she should in her boss's office, she has an 'accident', falling from the top floor of the building to the street below. Awoken by the licking of cats, she is surprised to find herself still very much alive. She vows to take revenge on her boss and becomes a female avenger, defending women under attack and providing assistance to Batman's efforts to keep the streets of Gotham safe. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie) - 1992-06-19

programme.title: Batman Forever
programme.desc: DA Harvey Dent and vengeful scientist The Riddler plan to take down Batman, as Dent wrongly believes that it is Batman's fault he was disfigured, and the scientist is angry with Bruce Wayne for rejecting his experiments. The Gotham City superhero is going to need his new partner, boy wonder Robin, but will he be able to cope with the distraction of sexy doctor Chase Meridian? (Action, Adventure, Crime, Fantasy, Movie) - 1995-06-16

programme.title: Batman & Robin
programme.desc: Batman battles super-villain Mr Freeze and seductive eco-terrorist Poison Ivy. With Freeze planning a permanent winter, faithful butler Alfred falling to a mysterious illness, and Ivy coming between the caped crusader and Robin, teaming up with Batgirl is the crime-fighting duo's only chance of saving the day. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction) - 1997-06-20

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: The curse of an ancient mummy protects buried treasure in the Egyptian desert. programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: The evil mummy Imhotep returns to wreak havoc as he resumes his relentless search for power and immortality. To make matters worse, another ancient evil has been unleashed, even more dangerous than Imhotep. Only the heroic Rick O'Connell and his intrepid Egyptologist wife stand in the way of these twin terrors as they embark upon a desperate mission to save the world. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Thriller) - 2001-04-29

programme.title: The Scorpion King
programme.desc: In a time before the pyramids, an evil king threatens to take over the world, so the leaders of the remaining tribes under threat call upon a desert warrior to help them defeat the wicked one and his brutal hordes. Harris), assumes control of the gang, which angers Tommy's best henchman, Zach (Tony King), who goes on to collaborate with D'Angelo and frame Papa Gibbs for the murder of Tommy's ex-wife. This sets off a series of bloody betrayals that ricochet within the crime world. (Crime drama) - 1973

programme.title: They Call Me Mister Tibbs!
programme.desc: In this sequel to "In The Heat of the Night," Detective Virgil Tibbs (Sidney Poitier) must solve the murder of a prostitute. The last person witnessed with the victim is Tibbs' friend, Logan Sharpe (Martin Landau), a preacher and activist. Despite his loyalty, Tibbs must investigate when Sharpe admits having visited the prostitute. In addition to his police work, Tibbs must also ease tension with his wife (Barbara McNair), who wants him to spend more time with her and their children. (Crime drama) - 1970

programme.title: The Limbic Region
programme.desc: In San Francisco in the 1970s, a serial killer calling himself The Scorekeeper sends taunting notes to the police and media after each of his kills. Although the case is long closed, obsessed detective Jon Lucca (Edward James Olmos) still suspects the wrong man was named as the killer. Learning he has only weeks to live, Lucca meets with Lloyd Ward (George Dzundza) -- the man he has long been convinced is the murderer, but never had enough evidence to arrest -- intending to force a confession. (Thriller) - 1996

programme.desc: When nightclub owner Langston (Larry D. Johnson) refuses to sell out to local mob boss Morgan (Robert Quarry), he is beaten to death by a gang of hired thugs. His grief-stricken fiancée, Diana "Sugar" Hill (Marki Bey), vows revenge for his murder and turns to aged voodoo authority Mama Maitresse (Zara Cully). Together they conjure up the demonic spirit of Baron Samedi (Don Pedro Colley), who agrees to help Sugar. He raises an army of zombies and sets them upon Langston's killers. (Horror) - 1974

programme.desc: Beautiful Elizabeth Blythe comes from New York to Tombstone to write a story about the town too tough to die; her nose for news promptly leads her into mortal danger when she is captured by outlaw Ed Chandler. (Western) - 1959-10-30

programme.desc: When Swedish-American whaler George Hansen returns to his Texas hometown after 20 years at sea, he's shocked to learn that his father was murdered just two days prior. The feckless local sheriff won't do anything about it, so George investigates on his own and discovers that an oil speculator had his father killed for refusing to sell his land at an unfair price. Enraged, and armed only with a speargun, George goes looking for justice. (Western) - 1958

programme.title: Cast a Long Shadow
programme.desc: Chip (John Dehner), a ranch foreman, approaches aimless hard-drinker Matt Brown (Audie Murphy) in a New Mexico bar. The owner of Chip's ranch has died and left Matt his land, thinking the troubled drifter may be his long-estranged son. Initially, Matt plans on selling the ranch, but then decides to keep it, hoping to impress his ex-lover, Janet (Terry Moore). The ranch, however, turns out to be in foreclosure, forcing Matt and Chip to come up with a plan to pay off their debt to the bank. (Western) - 1959

programme.title: The Gambler Wore a Gun
programme.desc: The new owner (Jim Davis) of a ranch has a problem with the deed, caused by a noose. (Western) - 1961

programme.title: Oklahoma Territory
programme.desc: Amid conflicts between the Cherokee tribe and Oklahoma's white settlers, the tribe's chief, Buffalo Horn (Ted de Corsia), is framed for murder. District Attorney Temple Houston (Bill Williams) must put aside his friendship with the chief and budding romance with the chief's daughter, Ruth Red Hawk (Gloria Talbott), to prosecute the case. Although Buffalo Horn has a solid alibi for the time of the killing, the political and business corruption of the territory makes a fair trial difficult. (Western) - 1960

programme.title: Bandera Bandits
programme.desc: A lawman (Telly Savalas) is determined to catch a pair of ruthless criminals (Tomas Milian, Susan George) as they rob their way across Mexico. (Western, Comedy) - 1972

programme.desc: Deputy Marshal Frank Smeed (Howard Duff) guns down an innocent Mexican who was about to deliver a huge sum of gold to a land tycoon, then makes off with the loot and covers his tracks by claiming that the man he shot was a dangerous criminal. Deputy Marshal Bill Gantry (Bill Williams) is charged with investigating the matter to ensure that his close friend Smeed was in the right. When he gets too close to discovering the truth, the crooked deputy tries to make Gantry his next victim. (Western) - 1956

She approaches Sam to retrieve the gold from the bottom of a river and smuggle it back into the mint. The widow's beauty, and the nice sum she promises him, leave Sam powerless to resist the preposterous proposal. (Western, Comedy) - 1969

Fleeing to the United States, they come across a band of scalp hunters and are prevented from massacring them by the Comanche chief of the Antelope tribe, Quanah (Kent Smith). Despite the efforts of frontier scout Jim Read (Dana Andrews), turmoil erupts between the whites and the rebel Comanche, and Quanah and Read struggle to restore peace. (Western) - 1956

At first Beaudray does everything he can to ditch Wanda -- until the girl chances upon a treasure map. But Wanda and Beaudray aren't the only ones after the loot, and they must contend with a ruthless pair of crooks. (Western, Comedy) - 1979

programme.title: Revolt at Fort Laramie
programme.desc: At the dawn of the American Civil War, tensions begin to mount between Northern and Southern sympathizers stationed at Fort Laramie in Wyoming. The Southern soldiers, led by Maj. Seth Bradner (John Dehner), leave Fort Laramie to join the Confederate cause. But when Bradner is captured by a fortune-seeking Sioux tribe en route to Texas, it's up to Capt. James Tenslip (Gregg Palmer), a Northerner who has fallen for Bradner's niece Melissa (Frances Helm), to save him. (Western) - 1957

programme.title: Frontier Uprising
programme.desc: A wagon train heads for California unaware that local Indians have sided with Mexico against the United States. (Western) - 1961

programme.title: Fort Defiance
programme.desc: After the Civil War, veteran Ben Shelby (Ben Johnson) travels to Arizona to seek out fellow veteran Johnny Tallon (Dane Clark). After saving Johnny's blind brother, Ned (Peter Graves), from being trampled by a horse, Ben accompanies him to the family ranch. While Ben and Ned become friends, Ned's uncle grows suspicious about Ben's claim of friendship with Johnny. As they all wait for news of Johnny, they face an Indian attack and the arrival of vengeful former soldiers also seeking Johnny. (Western) - 1951

programme.title: Fort Yuma
programme.desc: Apaches plan to attack a fort by wearing uniforms plundered from a cavalry officer's (Peter Graves) supply column. (Western) - 1955

programme.title: Drango
programme.desc: With the Civil War still a fresh memory, Maj. Clint Drango of the Union Army must restore order to Kennesaw Pass, Georgia. However, even with the trusty Capt. Marc Banning along, he faces a distrustful town, as well as former Confederates led by the manipulative Clay Allen. A high-stakes battle of wills ensues as Drango, who hides a dark secret related to the town, must win the people's support to prevent the Union Army from intervening. (Western) - 1957

programme.title: Grayeagle
programme.desc: One day while reputable trapper John Colter (Ben Johnson) is away from home, his adoring daughter Beth (Lana Wood) is captured by the notorious Indian Grayeagle (Alex Cord). But, as her father begins his tireless search to recover her, Beth is surprised to discover that there is more to Grayeagle than his fearsome reputation would imply. As she grows to realize that he is a man of honor -- much like her father -- she begins to fall in love with this proud Cheyenne warrior. (Western) - 1977

programme.title: Man With the Gun
programme.desc: Sheridan City is out of control. The citizens are corrupt, the saloon is an immoral indulgence, and gunmen and greedy opportunists come and go as they please. With the town's lawman (Henry Hull) incapable of maintaining order, the town council brings in a hired gun, Clint Tollinger (Robert Mitchum), who has business of his own with the saloon madame (Jan Sterling). Tollinger sets about proving his reputation as a "town tamer" through his signature approach: eradicating violence with violence. (Western) - 1955

Years later, the adult Jeff (Ben Cooper), who never forgave Ruth for her deception, begins to search for his fugitive father, and becomes an outlaw himself when he engages in an ill-advised stagecoach robbery. (Western) - 1957

However, he cannot even begin to get his life in order before his mother (Clarissa Kaye) is arrested and falsely charged with murder. This is the last straw for Ned, who goes on a crime spree with his group, including Joe Byrne (Mark McManus) and Ned's brother, Dan (Allen Bickford). However, eventually the law catches up to them, forcing a fateful showdown. (Biography) - 1970

He slowly falls in love with her and her baby, but she's still looking for the perfect partner, not realising he's right under her nose. However, we can hear the baby's thoughts, and he wants the guy as his dad.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Too
programme.desc: A wisecracking toddler deals with toilet training, bickering parents and a baby sister in this sequel to the 1989 hit.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Now
programme.desc: In the third of the 'Look Who's Talking' comedies, two dogs enter the Umbriacco household - and take an immediate dislike to each other. When Molly loses her job, husband James is forced to take on a demanding role as private airline pilot. The children miss him, so he buys a dog to cheer them up. However, when James's glamorous boss asks his family to look after her poodle, sparks fly between the dogs.

programme.title: Yogi Bear
programme.desc: Yogi, Boo Boo, and Ranger Smith team up to try to stop the mayor from closing Jellystone Park and selling it to loggers.

programme.title: The LEGO NINJAGO Movie
programme.desc: Master Wu, who is as wise-cracking as he is wise, leads a fierce team of secret ninja warriors to defeat the evil warlord Garmadon and save Ninjago City. He will need all of his cunning and guile to defeat his enemy.

programme.title: Shaun the Sheep Movie
programme.desc: When Shaun decides to take the day off and have some fun, he gets more than he bargained for. A mix-up with the farmer, a caravan and a very steep hill lead Shaun and the flock to the big city, and it's up to Shaun to return everyone home safely.

programme.title: A Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon
programme.desc: When an alien possessing strange powers crash-lands near Mossy Bottom Farm, Shaun the Sheep quickly makes a new friend. Together they must run from a dangerous organisation who wants to capture the intergalactic visitor.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.

programme.title: Dog Man
programme.desc: A life-saving surgery fuses together a police officer and his faithful police dog -- and Dog Man is born. Learning to embrace his new identity, Dog Man must stop feline supervillain Petey the Cat from cloning himself and going on a crime spree.

programme.title: Cloudy With a Chance of Meatballs
programme.desc: Inventor Flint Lockwood dreams of discovering an idea that will change people's lives forever, and after several misguided attempts he may just have done it. Flint has invented a machine that can turn water into delicious food, and, when his first demonstration accidentally sends the machine shooting into the clouds, cheeseburgers begin raining down from the sky.

programme.title: Cloudy With a Chance of Meatballs 2
programme.desc: Discovering that his most famous machine is now creating animal/vegetable hybrids, inventor Flint Lockwood and his friends venture forth to save the world from tacodiles, shrimpanzees and other creatures.

programme.title: Madagascar
programme.desc: Spoiled by their upbringing and with no idea of what wildlife is really like, Alex the lion, Marty the zebra, Gloria the hippo and hypochondriac giraffe Melman swap New York's Central Park Zoo for Madagascar.

programme.title: Madagascar: Escape 2 Africa
programme.desc: The sequel to 'Madagascar', in which New York Zoo animals, Alex the Lion, Marty the Zebra, Melman the Giraffe and Gloria the Hippo, still stranded on Madagascar, start to leave the island. All of a sudden, they land in the wilderness of Africa, where Alex meets the rest of his family, but has trouble communicating with them after spending so much time at the Central Park Zoo. A DreamWorks animation.

programme.title: Goosebumps
programme.desc: A young kid teams up with the niece of young adult horror author RL Stine after the writer's imaginary demons are set free on the town of Greendale, Maryland.

programme.title: Goosebumps 2
programme.desc: Best friends meet, a mischievous dummy who brings his ghoulish friends back to life, just in time for Halloween. As the town becomes overrun with monsters, the boys join forces to save the town from Slappy's wicked plan.

programme.title: Annie
programme.desc: Ever since her parents left her as a baby, little Annie has led a hard-knock life with her mean foster-mother, Miss Hannigan. However, that all changes when hard-nosed billionaire and mayor candidate Will Stacks takes her in on the recommendation of his advisers. Stacks believes that he's Annie's guardian angel, but the plucky youngster's confidence and sunny outlook may mean that Annie will save Will instead.

programme.title: Babe
programme.desc: Engaging family tale based on Dick King-Smith's classic story about an orphaned piglet which is adopted by a sheepdog and learns how to herd sheep. Babe at first seems destined to end up on the dining table at Christmas, but the farmer realises that the animal's unusual talent may bring him glory in the sheepdog trials.

programme.title: The Borrowers
programme.desc: A four-inch-tall family live beneath the floorboards of a human house. The family's future is threatened when the house falls into the hands of an evil lawyer who plans to destroy it.

programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
programme.desc: SpongeBob goes on a quest to discover a stolen recipe that takes him to our world, where he tangles with a pirate.

programme.title: Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Skipper, Kowalski, Rico and Private are recruited by a secret organisation to help bring down an evil supervillain, Doctor Octavius Brine. He holds a grudge against the animals that stole the limelight from him.

programme.title: Hitpig!
programme.desc: A clever bounty-hunting pig must return a dancing elephant to a Las Vegas circus to collect $1 million. However, when the mission goes sideways, he soon realises that no amount of money is worth losing his newfound friends.

programme.title: The Swan Princess: The Secret of the Castle
programme.desc: A princess and prince's wedding anniversary celebrations are rudely interrupted by an evil wizard, who once again wants to conquer the world.

programme.title: Dr. Seuss' the Lorax
programme.desc: A young boy searches for a way to gain the affections of his dream-girl. In his quest he learns that in order to succeed he must uncover the story of the grumpy but nature-loving Lorax.

programme.title: The Boss Baby
programme.desc: A new baby's arrival impacts a family, told from the point of view of a delightfully unreliable narrator, a wildly imaginative Seven-year-old named Tim. The most unusual Boss Baby arrives at Tim's home in a taxi, wearing a suit and carrying a briefcase. The instant sibling rivalry must soon be put aside when Tim discovers that Boss Baby is actually a spy on a secret mission, and only he can help thwart a dastardly plot that involves an epic battle between puppies and babies.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania
programme.desc: Dracula, who operates a high-end resort away from the human world, goes into overprotective mode when a boy discovers the resort and falls for the count's teenage daughter.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 2
programme.desc: Concerned that his half-human grandson isn't showing his vampire side, Dracula decides to put his grandson through 'monster' boot camp. Then, Dracula's father unexpectedly pays a visit.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 3: A Monster Vacation
programme.desc: Mavis surprises Dracula with plans for a fun-filled summer voyage on a monster cruise. As the pack starts enjoying colossal buffets and exotic excursions, Drac finds himself falling for the ship's intriguing but dangerous captain. He soon learns that trying to balance family, friends and romance might just be too much to handle. Even for the world's most powerful vampire.

On arrival at his new home, the diminutive rodent receives a lukewarm welcome by the boy - and an even frostier reception from the pet cat. Featuring a mixture of live action and animation.

programme.title: Stuart Little 2
programme.desc: Sequel to the children's story about the adventures of a small mouse, blending live action and computer-animated characters. The eponymous hero befriends a tiny bird wounded by a sinister falcon, but he must enlist the help of the dreaded family cat if he is to protect his new-found friend.

programme.title: A Dog's Purpose

The cats' leader, Mr Tinkles, plans to steal the serum, but first he must get past fearless dog agent Lou who, thanks to a mistake in recruitment, guards the Brody family.

The duo discovers that the postal stagecoach has been held up by Frank Hayden (Steve Darrell) and his band of thieves, and that the criminals are in hiding. Edward is a vampire whose family does not drink blood, and Bella, far from being frightened, enters into a dangerous romance with her immortal soulmate. programme.desc: Night Is Not Eternal is a deeply personal exploration of political activism through the eyes of Chinese American filmmaker Nanfu Wang. For over seven years, Nanfu follows Rosa Maria Paya, a young Cuban activist and daughter of five-time Nobel Peace Prize nominee Oswaldo Paya, in her fight for democratic change in Cuba. Driven by her own experiences in China, Nanfu is drawn to Rosa's story and the parallels between their homelands. With intimate access, Nanfu follows Rosa's journey from the streets of Havana to rallies and conferences worldwide, capturing her transformation from a grassroots activist to an international public figure and documenting the challenges faced by activists resisting authoritarian regimes. (Special, Documentary) - 2024

Bick and Leslie get married, but she clashes with his sister, Luz (Mercedes McCambridge), and wins the admiration of the ambitious young Jett Rink (James Dean). Bick and Jett form a tense rivalry that continues to surface as the years pass and fortunes change in this sweeping drama. (Drama) - 1956

programme.title: All About Eve
programme.desc: Backstage story revolving around aspiring actress Eve Harrington. Tattered and forlorn, Eve shows up in the dressing room of Broadway mega-star Margo Channing, telling a melancholy life story to Margo and her friends. Margo takes Eve under her wing, and it appears that Eve is a conniver that uses Margo. (Drama) - 1950

programme.title: East of Eden
programme.desc: In this film based on John Steinbeck's epic novel, Cal Trask (James Dean), the son of a California farmer (Raymond Massey), feels that his father cares only about his brother, Aron (Richard Davalos). When Cal embarks on a business venture to gain the favor of his dad, he finds himself dealing with his estranged mother (Jo Van Fleet), now the owner of a brothel, and tensions in the family rise even further when he begins to fall for Aron's girlfriend, Abra (Julie Harris). (Drama) - 1955

programme.title: Creepy Bits - Hors d'Oeuvre

programme.title: All the President's Men
programme.desc: Two green reporters and rivals working for the Washington Post, Bob Woodward (Robert Redford) and Carl Bernstein (Dustin Hoffman), research the botched 1972 burglary of the Democratic Party Headquarters at the Watergate apartment complex. With the help of a mysterious source, code-named Deep Throat (Hal Holbrook), the two reporters make a connection between the burglars and a White House staffer. Despite dire warnings about their safety, the duo follows the money all the way to the top. (Docudrama) - 1976

programme.title: The Great Waldo Pepper
programme.desc: Aerial tale set in the 1920s about a traveling aviator whose exaggerations look to be discovered when he begins work on a film with a pilot with whom he claims to have done battle. Having told colorful stories of wartime combat with the notorious German flying ace, the two men fortunately find a mutual respect, which culminates in a spectacular dogfight. (Adventure, Drama) - 1975

programme.title: Silent Running
programme.desc: After the end of all botanical life on Earth, ecologist Freeman Lowell (Bruce Dern) maintains a greenhouse on a space station in order to preserve various plants for future generations. Assisted by three robots and a small human crew, Lowell rebels when he is ordered to destroy the greenhouse in favor of carrying cargo, a decision that puts him at odds with everyone but his mechanical companions. Lowell and his robots are forced to do anything necessary to keep their invaluable greenery alive. (Science fiction) - 1972

programme.title: How to Steal a Million
programme.desc: Charles Bonnet (Hugh Griffith) expresses his passion for art by forging masterpieces -- and selling them at a hefty profit. The trouble starts when his reproduction of a prized sculpture winds up in a famous Paris museum. If experts determine that it is inauthentic, Bonnet's reputation will be tarnished. That's why his fetching daughter, Nicole (Audrey Hepburn), hires cat burglar Simon Dermott (Peter O'Toole) to steal the sculpture back before it's too late. (Comedy) - 1966

programme.title: Good Morning, Vietnam
programme.desc: Radio funny man Adrian Cronauer (Robin Williams) is sent to Vietnam to bring a little comedy back into the lives of the soldiers. While Dickerson attempts to censor Cronauer's broadcasts, Cronauer pursues a relationship with a Vietnamese girl named Trinh (Chintara Sukapatana), who shows him the horrors of war first-hand. (Comedy, War, Drama) - 1987

programme.title: The English Patient
programme.desc: The sweeping expanses of the Sahara are the setting for a passionate love affair in this adaptation of Michael Ondaatje's novel. A badly burned man, Laszlo de Almasy (Ralph Fiennes), is tended to by a nurse, Hana (Juliette Binoche), in an Italian monastery near the end of World War II. His past is revealed through flashbacks involving a married Englishwoman (Kristin Scott Thomas) and his work mapping the African landscape. Hana learns to heal her own scars as she helps the dying man. (Romance, War, Historical drama) - 1996

programme.title: Crimson Tide
programme.desc: After the Cold War, a breakaway Russian republic with nuclear warheads becomes a possible worldwide threat. U.S. submarine Capt. Frank Ramsey (Gene Hackman) signs on a relatively green but highly recommended Lt. Cmdr. Ron Hunter (Denzel Washington) to the USS Alabama, which may be the only ship able to stop a possible Armageddon. When Ramsay insists that the Alabama must act aggressively, Hunter, fearing they will start rather than stop a disaster, leads a potential mutiny to stop him. (Thriller, Drama) - 1995

programme.title: Courage Under Fire
programme.desc: During the 1991 Gulf War, Lieutenant Colonel Nathaniel Serling (Denzel Washington) accidentally caused a friendly fire incident, a mistake that was hushed up by his superiors. Following the war, he is assigned to investigate the case of Army Captain Karen Walden (Meg Ryan), killed in action when her Medevac unit was attempting to rescue the crew of a downed helicopter. But, as Serling interviews the members of Walden's crew, he realizes their stories about the incident don't add up. (Action, Drama, Mystery) - 1996

programme.title: G.I. Jane
programme.desc: In response to political pressure from Senator Lillian DeHaven (Anne Bancroft), the U.S. Navy begins a program that would allow for the eventual integration of women into its services. The program begins with a single trial candidate, Lieutenant Jordan O'Neil (Demi Moore), who is chosen specifically for her femininity. O'Neil enters the grueling training program under the command of John James Urgayle (Viggo Mortensen), who unfairly pushes O'Neil until her determination wins his respect. (Drama, Action) - 1997

programme.desc: All Happy Gilmore (Adam Sandler) has ever wanted is to be a professional hockey player. But he soon discovers he may actually have a talent for playing an entirely different sport: golf. When his grandmother (Frances Bay) learns she is about to lose her home, Happy joins a golf tournament to try and win enough money to buy it for her. With his powerful driving skills and foulmouthed attitude, Happy becomes an unlikely golf hero -- much to the chagrin of the well-mannered golf professionals. (Comedy) - 1996

programme.title: Dumb and Dumber
programme.desc: Imbecilic best friends Lloyd Christmas (Jim Carrey) and Harry Dunne (Jeff Daniels) stumble across a suitcase full of money left behind in Harry's car by Mary Swanson (Lauren Holly), who was on her way to the airport. The pair decide to go to Aspen, Colo., to return the money, unaware that it is connected to a kidnapping. As Harry and Lloyd -- who has fallen in love with Mary -- are pursued across the country by hired killers and police, they find both their friendship and their brains tested. (Comedy) - 1994

Austin then falls for Caldwell's daughter, Donna (Meg Ryan), further complicating matters. Still, the two men push on in their search, learning to respect one another as they pursue the killer. programme.title: The Green Mile
programme.desc: Paul Edgecomb walks the mile with a variety of cons. He has never encountered someone like John Coffey, a massive black man convicted of brutally killing a pair of young sisters. Coffey has the size and strength to kill anyone, but not the demeanor. Beyond his simple, naive nature and a deathly fear of the dark, Coffey seems to possess a prodigious, supernatural gift. Paul begins to question whether Coffey is truly guilty of murdering the two girls. (Movie, Drama, Fantasy, Crime) - 1999

programme.title: The Shawshank Redemption
programme.desc: Andy Dufresne (Tim Robbins) is sentenced to two consecutive life terms in prison for the murders of his wife and her lover and is sentenced to a tough prison. However, only Andy knows he didn't commit the crimes. While there, he forms a friendship with Red (Morgan Freeman), experiences brutality of prison life, adapts, helps the warden, etc., all in 19 years. (Movie, Drama, Crime) - 1994

programme.title: Gran Torino
programme.desc: Retired autoworker and Korean War vet Walt Kowalski fills emptiness in his life with beer and home repair, despising the many Asian, Latino and black families in his neighborhood. Walt becomes a reluctant hero when he stands up to the gangbangers who tried to force an Asian teen to steal Walt's treasured car. An unlikely friendship develops between Walt and the teen, as he learns he has more in common with his neighbors than he thought. (Movie, Drama) - 2008
